lines.text: A coworker texts you. Honest question. If God is good, why does my sister have cancer?
lines.cap: A coworker texts you. / Honest question. / If God is good, / why does my sister have cancer?

lines.text: What do you type back?
lines.cap: What do you type back?

lines.text: Most of us freeze. Not because we don't believe, but because we've never practiced saying it out loud, to someone who pushes back.
lines.cap: Most of us freeze. / Not because we don't believe, / but because we've never practiced / saying it out loud, / to someone who pushes back.

lines.text: Pilots train in simulators. Surgeons practice on models. So where do Christians practice the hardest conversations about faith?
lines.cap: Pilots train in simulators. / Surgeons practice on models. / So where do Christians practice / the hardest conversations / about faith?

lines.text: Peter wrote, always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect.
Being prepared takes practice.
lines.cap: Being prepared takes practice.

lines.text: So we built Apologist Academy. A safe place to practice the hard questions, before someone asks you for real.
lines.cap: So we built Apologist Academy. / A safe place to practice / the hard questions, / before someone asks you for real.

lines.text: Pick one of sixteen questions across eight topics, from suffering to science to other faiths. No account. Nothing to install.
lines.cap: Pick one of sixteen questions / across eight topics, / from suffering to science / to other faiths. / No account. / Nothing to install.

lines.text: Then choose who you're talking to. Curious asks honest questions. Hostile pushes hard, but stays civil. And you set how hard it pushes.
lines.cap: Then choose who you're talking to. / Curious asks honest questions. / Hostile pushes hard, / but stays civil. / And you set how hard it pushes.

lines.text: Now you talk it through, for five turns. Type your reply, or just speak it.
lines.cap: Now you talk it through, / for five turns. / Type your reply, / or just speak it.

lines.text: The skeptic isn't reading from a script. It answers what you actually said. Pick a tougher skeptic, and it won't let a vague answer slide.
lines.cap: The skeptic isn't reading / from a script. / It answers what you actually said. / Pick a tougher skeptic, / and it won't let a vague answer slide.

lines.text: Stuck? Ask Coach. It helps in steps. First a hint. Then an outline. Then a sample reply, only if you want it. The goal is to find your own words.
lines.cap: Stuck? Ask Coach. / It helps in steps. / First a hint. / Then an outline. / Then a sample reply, / only if you want it. / The goal is to find your own words.

lines.text: Because this isn't a debate to win. It's a person to listen to.
lines.cap: Because this isn't a debate to win. / It's a person to listen to.

lines.text: After five turns, Coach writes you a short review. What you covered, what you could add, and a verse to study. No scores. No grades.
lines.cap: After five turns, / Coach writes you a short review. / What you covered, / what you could add, / and a verse to study. / No scores. No grades.

lines.text: Print it, and bring it to your small group. It doesn't replace your church. It helps you get ready for real conversations.
lines.cap: Print it, / and bring it to your small group. / It doesn't replace your church. / It helps you get ready / for real conversations.

lines.text: And it works on any screen.
lines.cap: And it works on any screen.

lines.text: We built it carefully. The AI is always labeled. The skeptic never pretends to be converted, and never insults you or your faith.
lines.cap: We built it carefully. / The AI is always labeled. / The skeptic never pretends / to be converted, / and never insults you or your faith.

lines.text: If someone seems to be in crisis, it stops the exercise and points them to real help. And Coach quotes one checked verse, and never makes up sources.
lines.cap: If someone seems to be in crisis, / it stops the exercise / and points them to real help. / And Coach quotes one checked verse, / and never makes up sources.

lines.text: Under the hood, our server sets the rules: five turns, separate instructions for each role, and a daily limit. The Apologist Project's AI platform plays the skeptic and powers Coach and the review, with memory turned off.
lines.cap: Under the hood, / our server sets the rules: / five turns, / separate instructions for each role, / and a daily limit. / The Apologist Project's AI platform / plays the skeptic / and powers Coach and the review, / with memory turned off.

lines.text: It's for small groups, students, new believers, and church leaders training their people.
lines.cap: It's for small groups, / students, new believers, / and church leaders / training their people.

lines.text: So the next time someone asks, you won't freeze. You'll be ready, with gentleness and respect.
lines.cap: So the next time someone asks, / you won't freeze. / You'll be ready, / with gentleness and respect.
